This module introduces you to R, RStudio, and R project management: the free, open-source toolkit behind much of modern palaeontology, ecology, and evolutionary biology. [R](https://www.r-project.org) is a programming language built for data analysis and visualisation, and [RStudio](https://posit.co/products/open-source/rstudio) makes it far friendlier to use.

**No prior coding experience required is required for this module**, and by the end, you will be navigating RStudio with confidence, writing and running your first R code, and organising your work in a project that you (or a collaborator) can pick up again months later.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

- Explain what R and RStudio are, how they relate, and how to navigate the main RStudio panels, including the difference between the console and a script
- Assign values to objects, manipulate them, and recognise common data types and structures
- Install and load packages to extend what R can do
- Import a dataset, inspect it, summarise it, and make a simple plot in base R
- Create an RStudio Project to keep your files, data, and code organised
- Interpret common errors and find help independently, so you can code in R and RStudio with confidence

## Prerequisites

### Knowledge

This module assumes no prior experience with R or programming. However, you should be comfortable with basic computer skills, such as downloading and installing software and managing files and folders.

### Installation

For this module, you will need to install [R](https://www.r-project.org) and [RStudio](https://posit.co/products/open-source/rstudio).

1. **Install R.** Download the latest version for your operating system from the [Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN)](https://cran.r-project.org/) and follow the installation instructions.
2. **Install RStudio Desktop.** Download the free version from the [Posit website](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) and install it as you would any other application.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Trouble installing?

If you cannot install software on your machine (e.g. a managed institutional laptop), you can run RStudio in your browser for free using [Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/). Alternatively, speak to your IT support team about installing R and RStudio.
:::

## Module structure

This module is designed to get you up and running with R and RStudio as quickly as possible and includes the following:

- [Introduction to R and RStudio](rstudio.qmd): Get to know R and the RStudio interface, and understand how R and RStudio work together.
- [R Basics](r-basics.qmd): Learn the fundamentals of the R language, including objects, data types, functions, packages, and importing data.
- [Project Management with RStudio](project-management.qmd): Organise your files, data, and code with RStudio Projects, and adopt habits that make your analyses reproducible.
